text:
zoe: Hi all, day 2 and hitting onboarding walls. Okta forces passkey enrollment but my company Pixel 8 says "No eligible authenticators" when I try to register. 1Password invite bounced with "email already claimed" (I think I accepted with personal address), and my SSH flow to the infra cert service keeps failing: `ssh -i ~/.ssh/id_ed25519-cert.pub infra-host` returns Permission denied (publickey). Who do I ping?

karim: Welcome Zoe :wave: For the Pixel, is the device enrolled in our MDM (Workspace One)? MDM can restrict WebAuthn. Check Settings > Security > Passkeys and confirm Chrome has fingerprint permissions. Also try register via Okta mobile app instead of browser.

zoe: Device is enrolled. I checked Chrome permission and it allowed biometrics. Okta still rejects with "No eligible authenticators". Tried Okta app, same.

it-help: Opening IT-3154. Two quick things: 1) Verify the Android SafetyNet attestation isn't blocked by our device profile. 2) Try to create a passkey in `chrome://settings/security` to see if platform passkeys are working generally. If that works, the issue is probably Okta policy.

people-ops: Re: 1Password, did you accept the invite to zoe.personal@gmail or zoe@redwood.com? If to personal, we can transfer the seat. File PEOPLE-5320 created.

zoe: I accepted on zoe.personal@gmail (I was testing earlier). Please transfer to zoe@redwood.com.

karim: For the SSH cert issue: our infra uses short-lived user certs via `ssh-cert` service. You need to run `ssh-cert request --role=dev` which talks to the SSO-backed CA and writes `~/.ssh/id_ed25519-cert.pub`. If your cert file is missing or expired you'll get publickey errors. Try `ssh-cert status` and `ssh-cert request`.

zoe: `ssh-cert status` says "no valid cert found". Running `ssh-cert request --role=dev` errors: "authentication failed: SSO token required".

sec-ops: If `ssh-cert` asks for SSO token, that means your Okta session didn't register a passkey or fallback MFA. We can allow a one-time SSO session via device code. Run `ssh-cert request --device-code` and paste the code into the URL it gives. I'll temporarily whitelist that request (10 min).

it-help: Also checking IT-3154: MDM shows a policy blocking FIDO attestation for app-origin `okta.redwood.com`. I'm switching your device to a relaxed profile and will push a new policy in a minute.

deploy-bot: IT-3154 created and assigned to it-help. PEOPLE-5320 created and assigned to people-ops.

people-ops: Seat transfer in progress, new invite sent to zoe@redwood.com. Reply when accepted.

zoe: Accepted corporate 1Password invite, thanks. Ran `ssh-cert request --device-code` and pasted the code; got `certificate written to ~/.ssh/id_ed25519-cert.pub`. SSH to infra-host now works.

it-help: Policy change deployed to your device; after a quick reboot Okta passkey enrollment should succeed. Try enrolling now or use the Okta app as fallback.

zoe: Rebooted and enrolled passkey successfully via Chrome platform authenticator. All unblocked. Appreciate the quick coordination! :tada:

it-help: IT-3154 status = Resolved (notes: relaxed MDM profile for passkey attestation, verified registration), PEOPLE-5320 = Closed. If anyone else on Pixel sees this, ping IT and reference IT-3154.
